pages.title: About Scented Bubbles
pages.content:
At Scented Bubbles, we believe every space and moment deserves an aura of quiet luxury. Born from a devotion to artisanal perfumery, our creations balance French perfumery heritage with contemporary refinement.

From long-lasting Eau de Parfums to slow-evaporating wooden car diffusers, every batch of Scented Bubbles is hand-blended with IFRA-compliant fragrance oils, pure essential extracts, and cosmetic-grade carriers.

pages.title: Shipping Policy | Scented Bubbles
pages.content:
Orders placed at Scented Bubbles are dispatched within 24 to 48 business hours. We deliver across India with premium courier partners including Blue Dart, Delhivery, and DTDC.

Standard delivery takes 3 to 6 business days. Free shipping is automatically applied to all orders above ₹999.

pages.title: Returns & Refunds | Scented Bubbles
pages.content: Due to the personal nature of fine fragrances, Scented Bubbles cannot accept returns on opened perfume bottles or car diffusers. However, if your package arrives damaged, leaked, or incorrect, please reach out to care@scentedbubbles.com or message us on WhatsApp with an unboxing video within 48 hours for an instant replacement or refund.

pages.title: Terms & Conditions | Scented Bubbles
pages.content: Welcome to Scented Bubbles. By accessing or shopping on our website, you agree to these terms. All products, imagery, and formulas are proprietary to Scented Bubbles. Prices and product availability are subject to change without prior notice.

pages.title: Privacy Policy | Scented Bubbles
pages.content: Your privacy is paramount at Scented Bubbles. We collect customer name, phone number, and delivery address solely for fulfilling orders, tracking packages, and providing customer care. We never sell or lease your personal information to third parties.

products.name: Tam Dao (SRK)
products.short_description: Original Manufacturer oil made only perfume inspired by Tam Dao (signature scent of Shah Rukh Khan).
products.full_description: Original Manufacturer oil made only perfume inspired by Tam Dao, famously worn by Shah Rukh Khan. A masterclass in warmth and understated majesty, balancing sacred Goa sandalwood, crisp Italian cypress, and creamy white amber.
products.base_notes: Golden Amber, White Musk, Brazilian Rosewood
products.usage_instructions: Spritz 2-3 sprays on pulse points: collarbones, wrists, and behind the ears for all-day sillage.
products.inspired_by: Tam Dao (signature scent of Shah Rukh Khan)

products.name: Burberry Weekend
products.short_description: Original Manufacturer oil made only perfume inspired by Burberry Weekend.
products.full_description: Original Manufacturer oil made only perfume inspired by Burberry Weekend. Relaxing, luminous, and uplifting with sparkling mandarin, sweet nectarine, wild rose, and soft cedarwood.
products.heart_notes: Blue Hyacinth, Iris, Nectarine, Peach Blossom
products.usage_instructions: Spritz 2-3 sprays on pulse points: collarbones, wrists, and behind the ears for all-day sillage.

products.name: Azzaro Most Wanted
products.short_description: Original Manufacturer oil made only perfume inspired by Azzaro The Most Wanted.
products.full_description: Original Manufacturer oil made only perfume inspired by Azzaro The Most Wanted. An ultra-addictive, magnetic oriental fragrance featuring fiery cardamom, decadent toffee caramel, and smoky bourbon vanilla.
products.usage_instructions: Spritz 2-3 sprays on pulse points: collarbones, wrists, and behind the ears for all-day sillage.

products.name: YSL Libre
products.short_description: Original Manufacturer oil made only perfume inspired by YSL Libre.
products.full_description: Original Manufacturer oil made only perfume inspired by YSL Libre. A bold declaration of freedom uniting burning Moroccan orange blossom, crisp French lavender, and glowing Madagascar vanilla.
products.usage_instructions: Spritz 2-3 sprays on pulse points: collarbones, wrists, and behind the ears for all-day sillage.

products.name: Armani Tobacco
products.short_description: Original Manufacturer oil made only perfume inspired by Armani Privé Tobacco.
products.full_description: Original Manufacturer oil made only perfume inspired by Armani Privé Tobacco. An aristocratic, intoxicating blend of rich aromatic pipe tobacco, sweet dried fruits, honey, and warm oriental resins.
products.top_notes: Spicy Ginger, Blonde Tobacco Leaf, Osmanthus
